rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a person or thing in good health, and for a healthy type of food, lifestyle, or habit.

example.english: My lifestyle has been quite healthy lately, and I feel great.
example.traditional: 我最近生活幾健康，精神都好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 sang1 wut6 gei2 gin6 hong1 zing1 san4 dou1 hou2

rows.note: Use this when something is specifically beneficial to health rather than merely described as healthy.

example.jyutping: sik6 do1 di1 so1 coi3 jau5 jik1 gin6 hong1

rows.note: Use this when someone looks healthy, especially because their complexion or general appearance is good.

example.english: You look healthy now after getting enough rest.
example.traditional: 你休息夠，依家氣色好好多喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 jau1 sik1 gau3 ji1 gaa1 hei3 sik1 hou2 hou2 do1 laa3
